title: Build-output measurements
responsibility: Formats native/Wasm build sizes, reviewed limits and comparisons separately by target.

inputs.name: emittedKey.target
inputs.description: Target kind for the ledger key.

inputs.name: harnessEmitted.unit
inputs.description: Unit with declared execution targets and emitted limits.

inputs.name: harnessEmitted.record
inputs.description: Record whose unprofiled, workload-free build measurement is used, or null.

inputs.name: emittedChange.sides
inputs.type: Array<{ units: HarnessUnit[]; record: HarnessRecord | null }>
inputs.description: Comparison sides in before/after order; targets are gathered from supplied unit definitions.

inputs.name: emittedTargets.index
inputs.description: Index with emitted growth values and notes.

inputs.name: emittedTargets.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier whose targets are requested.

outputs.name: emittedBytes
outputs.description: Count followed by byte for one, otherwise bytes.

outputs.name: emittedLabel
outputs.description: Friendly native-process or Wasm label, otherwise the original target.

outputs.name: emittedKey
outputs.description: artifact-bytes followed by a colon and target kind.

outputs.name: harnessEmitted
outputs.description: One line per declared process/Wasm target with size, limit and findings. Units declaring neither receive an explicit no-output line. Missing measurements remain unavailable.

outputs.name: emittedChange
outputs.description: Before and after numeric sizes or null, separately for process and Wasm targets declared on either side.

outputs.name: emittedTargets
outputs.description: Process/Wasm targets found in growth values or notes, in fixed target order.
